title: INDEX with PARTITIONBY and no current partition returns the row at the position in every partition
query: EVALUATE INDEX ( 1, ALL ( 'Product'[Category], 'Product'[Product], 'Product'[Price] ), ORDERBY ( 'Product'[Price], DESC ), PARTITIONBY ( 'Product'[Category] ) )

source.quote: The result of the query contains the best-selling brand for each category.
source.supports: INDEX ( 1, ..., ORDERBY ( [@Sales], DESC ), KEEP, PARTITIONBY ( 'Product'[Category] ) ) at the top of a query returns one row per category

derivation: Vehicles by price descending: Bike 100, Scooter 50; Accessories: Helmet 20, Lock 10. The first of each: Bike and Helmet.
